verses.original: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃ בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י
verses.literal: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: I will say to the LORD [You are] my refuge and my fortress my God in whom I trust

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ הַוּֽוֹת׃ מִדֶּ֥בֶר
verses.transliteration: kî hū yaṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā mip·paḥ yā·qūš haw·wō·wṯ mid·de·ḇer
verses.literal: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly plague

verses.original: יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ׀ וְתַֽחַת־ כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃ צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: yā·seḵ lāḵ bə·’eḇ·rā·ṯōw wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ- kə·nā·p̄āw teḥ·seh ’ă·mit·tōw ṣin·nāh wə·sō·ḥê·rāh
verses.literal: He will cover you with His feathers under His wings you will find refuge His faithfulness is a shield and rampart

verses.original: לֹא־ תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯî·rā mip·pa·ḥaḏ lā·yə·lāh mê·ḥêṣ yā·‘ūp̄ yō·w·mām
verses.literal: You will not fear the terror of the night nor the arrow that flies by day

verses.original: מִ֭דֶּבֶר יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ בָּאֹ֣פֶל מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mid·de·ḇer ya·hă·lōḵ bā·’ō·p̄el miq·qe·ṭeḇ yā·šūḏ ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: [nor] the pestilence that stalks in the darkness [nor] the calamity that destroys at noon

verses.original: אֶ֗לֶף יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨׀ וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ לֹ֣א אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ יִגָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·lep̄ yip·pōl miṣ·ṣid·də·ḵā ū·rə·ḇā·ḇāh mî·mî·ne·ḵā lō ’ê·le·ḵā yig·gāš
verses.literal: Though a thousand may fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand no [harm] will come near you

verses.original: רַ֭ק תַבִּ֑יט בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תִּרְאֶֽה׃ וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: raq ṯab·bîṭ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā tir·’eh wə·šil·lu·maṯ rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה שַׂ֣מְתָּ יְהוָ֣ה מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃ מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן
verses.literal: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling my refuge the Most High

verses.original: לֹֽא־ רָעָ֑ה תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ לֹא־ וְ֝נֶ֗גַע יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- rā·‘āh ṯə·’un·neh ’ê·le·ḵā lō- wə·ne·ḡa‘ yiq·raḇ bə·’ā·ho·le·ḵā
verses.literal: no evil will befall you no plague will approach your tent

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְצַוֶּה־ מַ֭לְאָכָיו לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמָרְךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ṣaw·weh- mal·’ā·ḵāw lāḵ liš·mā·rə·ḵā bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵe·ḵā
verses.literal: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways

verses.original: יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ עַל־ כַּפַּ֥יִם פֶּן־ תִּגֹּ֖ף רַגְלֶֽךָ׃ בָּאֶ֣בֶן
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·’ū·nə·ḵā ‘al- kap·pa·yim pen- tig·gōp̄ raḡ·le·ḵā bā·’e·ḇen
verses.literal: They will lift you up in their hands so that you will not strike your foot against a stone

verses.original: תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ עַל־ שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: tiḏ·rōḵ ‘al- ša·ḥal wā·p̄e·ṯen tir·mōs kə·p̄îr wə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: You will tread on the lion and cobra you will trample the young lion and serpent

verses.original: כִּ֤י חָ֭שַׁק בִ֣י וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ כִּֽי־ יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ
verses.transliteration: kî ḥā·šaq ḇî wa·’ă·p̄al·lə·ṭê·hū kî- yā·ḏa‘ šə·mî ’ă·śag·gə·ḇê·hū
verses.literal: Because he loves Me I will deliver him because he knows My name I will protect him

verses.original: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ אָנֹכִ֥י עִמּֽוֹ־ בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: When he calls out to Me I will answer him I will be with him in trouble I will deliver him and honor him
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation
